workload.robot_platform: 14-DoF Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Robot (3×RGB-D Cameras @ 60fps + 1000Hz Joint Proprioception)
workload.edge_compute_envelope: Onboard NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 64GB / Jetson Thor Module (<=120W Power Budget, Zero Cloud WAN Dependency for Reflex)
workload.control_sla: Hard Real-Time Control Loop SLA: >= 50.0 Hz (<= 20.0 ms Latency) with Sub-Millimeter Continuous Precision

tiers.name: Tier 1: 自回归离散动作 Token 逐词生成 (Vanilla OpenVLA / RT-2: 14 步串行吐词)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Autoregressive Discrete Action Tokenization (Vanilla OpenVLA / RT-2: 14 Serial Steps)
tiers.action_decoding_mechanism: Quantizes continuous joint angles into 256 discrete vocabulary bins; runs 14 sequential 7B LLM decode steps per action
tiers.system_coupling: Synchronous Blocking Loop (Robot freezes waiting 320ms for 14 tokens every frame)
tiers.recommended_for: Quasi-static tabletop pick-and-place research demos only; unusable for dynamic or contact-rich robotics due to 3.1 Hz stop-and-go lurches and 256-bin quantization error.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 单体 VLM + 20 步 DDPM 扩散动作头 (连续轨迹但去噪耗时 145ms)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Monolithic VLM + 20-Step DDPM Diffusion Action Head
tiers.action_decoding_mechanism: Generates continuous H=16 action chunks via 20 iterative DDPM denoising steps conditioned on VLM features
tiers.system_coupling: Synchronous Monolithic Loop (145ms latency between visual observation and motor actuation)
tiers.recommended_for: Slow single-arm manipulation without moving targets or reactive force feedback.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 双向并行动作块解码 + 流匹配动作头 (OpenVLA-OFT / π0 单体: 28ms 整块直出)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Bidirectional Parallel Action Chunking + Flow-Matching Head (OpenVLA-OFT / pi0 Monolithic)
tiers.action_decoding_mechanism: Replaces causal mask with bidirectional parallel query tokens + 4-step Flow-Matching / L1 continuous head (outputs H=50 steps at once)
tiers.system_coupling: Single-System Chunked Execution (35.7 Hz inference rate, but blind to new visual perturbations inside a 50-step chunk)
tiers.recommended_for: Standard bimanual manipulation benchmarks (ALOHA / LIBERO) on workstation GPUs.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 异步快慢双系统解耦 (System-2 7B VLM 5Hz + System-1 300M 单步流匹配 117.6Hz + 时间集成平滑)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Async Dual-System (System-2 7B VLM @ 5Hz + System-1 300M 1-Step Flow @ 117.6Hz + Temporal Ensembling)
tiers.action_decoding_mechanism: System-2 (7B VLM INT4/FP8) updates latent goal at 5Hz; System-1 (300M 1-Step Consistency/Rectified Flow in TensorRT) outputs H=16 chunks every 8.5ms
tiers.system_coupling: Lock-Free Shared-Memory Ring Buffer + Exponential Temporal Ensembling across overlapping action chunks
tiers.recommended_for: Production humanoid & industrial dexterous robots (GR00T N1 / Helix / pi0.5 class) demanding >100Hz reactive visuomotor control and 94.8% contact-rich success on onboard Jetson hardware.
